forecast_review.method_recorded: For each case and mode, use the original long-prompt pilot chosen TF wall as a conservative chosen-branch bound. Estimate candidate free-run prefill as (suffix512 diagnostic wall - measured decode wall) plus the nonnegative original prefill delta scaled by 1024/source_prompt_tokens. Estimate decode to 511 tokens at the measured suffix512 decode token rate, capped at each observed free-run length if it terminated early. Apply 0.7x–1.7x to per-case work and add observed single model load time. This intentionally uses same suffix512 result semantics only for timing; outputs/loop length may change at suffix1024.
forecast_review.stored_work_aggregation: Verified exact: per-case chosen wall reference plus summed free-run wall projections; one selected same-mode load added once. Stored case ranges are 0.7x and1.7x per-case work; total ranges recompute exactly. Chosen wall references match each mode/case original chosen branch wall in completed-summary165. Decode projections cap at511 replay steps or early observed output length; free-run prefill proxy is diagnostic elapsed minus measured decode, so first-token/prefill/warmup-before-first-replay is not lost.
